Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was very excited because today was his birthday and he couldn't wait for his birthday. His mommy said they were going to the party.

At the party, Timmy saw a big box of ingredients. He asked his mommy if they could have some cake. His mommy said yes, but they had to be careful. Timmy thought it looked boring. His mommy explained that they needed to clean up the mess first, but they still needed to examine them.

Timmy saw a box of bricks and asked his mommy if they could have some ingredients.
